newsitem.title: USA: Green Tree files $1 bln shelf.
newsitem.headline: Green Tree files $1 bln shelf.

text.p: Green Tree Financial Corp filed Tuesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf offering of up to $1 billion in asset-backed securities to be sold through the Green Tree Recreational Equipment and Consumer Trust.

The certificates and notes will represent ownership in a trust consisting of retail installments for a variety of consumer products and certain home equity loans, the St. Paul, Minn. company said in the shelf offering.
No underwriters were named in the shelf offering.
